sourceSentences: Pulverize can be buffered during Headbutt to cast with reduced cast time when the dash ends.
Displacement immunity will also resist the application of the stun.

If they are within 400 units upon arrival, he deals them magic damage and knocks them back 700 units [Reduced to 200 units if Pulverize was buffered during the dash] over 0.5 seconds while also stunning them for 0.75 seconds.
Both the lower the dash distance and the larger Alistar and/or his target, the faster the dash becomes; this scales hyperbolically.
Headbutt can knock enemies through terrain. The knockback stops short on walls that cannot be surpassed but the disable duration is not changed.
Displacement immunity will not resist the application of the stun.
At 5 stacks, Alistar's next basic attack on-hit against a champion within 6 seconds ends Trample's effects to deal bonus magic damage and stun the target for 1 second.
The on-hit effect can be blocked by spell shield, but the attack cannot.

Alistar generates a stack of Triumph for each enemy champion he stuns or displaces with his abilities, and each time a nearby enemy minion or non-epic monster dies. He generates 7 stacks if a nearby enemy champion or epic monster dies.
At 7 stacks, Alistar consumes them all to heal himself for 5% of his maximum health and nearby allied champions for 7% of his maximum health.
Alistar cleanses himself of all crowd control. For the next 7 seconds, he reduces incoming damage.
True damage cannot be reduced by any means and will deal full damage to Alistar during Unbreakable Will.
being able to cancel your headbutt with your Q mid charge to knock people up from a distance

if you're next to a wall that you know that your opponent won't fly through when you headbutt them you can actually delay your queue for a while in order to crowd control them for a bit longer because the enemy will actually remain airborne and stunned through the duration that they are getting pushed through the air
another great Alistar trick is that you can cast Q then Flash and you'll knock up enemies at your new position
this is also much faster than your normal WQ combo and it's much less predictable
you can use alistar's W to Target players or Monsters over a wall to get into the fight faster
this ability is essentially just a dash that requires a Target you can use this ability to run away Dodge skill shots

For combos, start with W and press Q while dashing to immediately use it upon arrival. Use E then attack away until you can stun your opponent. If your opponent's near terrain, use E then go in with W to hit them into the terrain.
Follow up with Q to knock them up then attack them to stun them for a stupidly long CC chain.
vu que l'adversaire est collé à un mur, c'est comme s'il se prenait le bump. Il va être en en projectile collé au mur durant longtemps
quand quelqu'un est collé à un mur, c'est un bon match-up de pousser la personne sur le mur pour optimiser le CC
Vous pouvez très bien trouver un dash sur un creep et une rupture, vous pouvez très bien trouver un flash Q et pousser l'adversaire sous la tour.
